title: nem csak..., hanem... is: "Not Only, But Also"

sections.title: Someone who's more than one thing
sections.content: csak means "only"; hanem means "but" (used specifically after a negative, unlike de). Together, nem csak X, hanem Y is ("not only X, but also Y") is the natural way to say someone is two things at once.

items.spanish: Nem csak kolléganőm, hanem barátnőm is.
items.english: Not only my colleague, but also my friend.

items.spanish: Nem csak szomszéd, hanem közös barát is.
items.english: Not only a neighbor, but also a mutual friend.

sections.content: hanem only replaces de after a negative — Nem lusta, hanem fáradt ("Not lazy, but tired") — everywhere else, de is still the word you want.
